label: X-propagation checks
subgoals: Model each uninitialized bit as a free value
Compare the checked signals across two resolutions of the unknowns
Report differences only where the signal is qualified as valid

label: Connectivity checking
subgoals: Turn each connection row into a source-equals-destination property
Add the delay and enabling condition the row specifies
Check each property on its small cone of logic

label: Clock-domain crossing formal
subgoals: Locate each crossing and check its synchronizer structure
Assert gray coding or a handshake for multi-bit crossings
Inject random synchronizer latency and re-check the functional properties
